component.name: Flatkeep
component.summary: Install and update Flatpak apps from GitHub releases

description.p: Some apps publish .flatpak files on GitHub before they reach Flathub. Flatkeep installs them and keeps them up to date when new releases come out.
Apps updated outside Flatkeep now show the right version: when the installed version matches the latest release, Flatkeep records it.
A release only counts as new if it was published after the one you have. Turning pre-releases off no longer shows an older release as new, and background checks never install an older version.
The code was rewritten following the How to Design Programs design recipe, with runnable examples that are checked before every build.
Ship PNG icons alongside the SVG so the app icon shows in every launcher.
